protocol.status: Fresh labels pending review; no inference performed.
protocol.scope: Targeted end-to-end validation of the approved did-question and counted-noun gap fixes; not a broad English quality score.
protocol.label_approval: Record approval separately and tie it to this exact draft hash before inference. Changes to label content require an explicit versioned amendment.
execution: Verify code, XML, model and approved label identities before one attempt per input.
Use existing frozen Qwen3 4B sentence generation, then built-in and supplemental rule evidence plus the existing reason layer.
Send only original learner text to generation; references are for scoring only.
Retain raw outputs, withheld proposals and failures; do not substitute an authored correction for model output.
Review actual delivered edits and reasons. Record separate generation and checker time; batch averages are not conversational latency.
protocol.human_output_review: Required even after reference matching. Label approval is not approval of model output.
protocol.limitations: Targeted 8 did errors + 8 count errors and 16 acceptable inputs; no broad-English superiority claim. Labels authored by the same assistant; exact-match novelty is not statistical independence.
protocol.next: Await user label review, then run a single attempt per input through actual sentence generation and both checker sources; do not tune during evaluation.

dataset.source: New assistant-authored sentences after candidate freeze; pending project-owner label review. Eight correct inputs pair with references; eight are counterexamples. This is targeted validation, not a representative population sample.
